question_text: Outline how adding RAM and using a suitable GPU can improve a workstation that trains large image models.
adaptation_rationale: Narrows generic hardware-upgrade responses to explicit primary-memory and GPU roles; no unsupported peripheral specification.
solution: More RAM holds more of the working data available for CPU processing. A GPU can carry out many similar numerical operations in parallel, helping model calculations.

marking_points.criterion: Larger working data capacity relevant to processing.
Links repeated numerical/model operations to its benefit.
